item.title: Student evidence still required
item.description:
Primary application — documentation update, 6 November 2026

Primary application model: Global Claude Haiku 5.5. The application ranks extracted PDF and policy text by keywords. Dated verification reports record their respective releases. Model cutover evidence.

Submission pack

The primary application is Policy Assistant. October sections below describe another historical test environment.

  • Read the current proposal for the problem, scope, architecture inputs for the student’s diagram, delivery plan, COST inputs and risks. The primary release guide retains features and evidence from successive releases.
  • Implemented: public signup, private PDFs/text/OCR, cited answers, history, policy drafts/publication/effective dates, shop configuration, aggregate feedback and consented support. Support collaboration adds claims, handovers and internal notes; it does not create a restricted staff role or access to customers’ private PDFs.
  • Latest recorded runtime snapshot: 322 Python passes, 11 live skips; 67 frontend passes; 20 HTTP checks passed, three QA identities and the test ticket cleaned. Forty frontend files and six Lambda hashes matched. The 5 November UTC timestamp corresponds to 6 November in Vietnam; this is not a new run whenever the page is read. No model/PDF/OCR/email calls in that HTTP run. Report, application CI.
  • Shop content remains DEMO. Approved real policies and scoped browser/accuracy/load/restore/email checks remain pending. The USD 50 budget only alerts; the USD 6.63 estimate/USD 20 budget below belong to an older environment and do not price the current application.
  • Actually published blogs, office/event evidence, a student-drawn diagram, Pricing Calculator and video remain personal deliverables. Draft articles are not published posts. Do not invent internship dates, daily activities, photographs or grades.

AI-assisted material requires student review, execution and explanation. DOM checks are not visual browser acceptance; artifacts/CI do not establish accuracy or SLA. Preserve previous failures, passes and images with their original environment.
